entities.name: Table T2 – GS Fixed Income Evolution of Fund Positioning 2010-2025
entities.brief: Annual bond asset share trends across fixed income categories
entities.description: Depicts multi-year shifts in bond asset shares, reflecting evolving investor sentiment toward quality, duration, and risk in fixed income markets.

properties.key_insight: Long Duration and IG Credit shares rose sharply to peaks by 2024-2025, Government-only shares rebounded, while High Yield and Leveraged Loan shares declined and Inflation-protected shares were volatile.
